card.situation:
Combined Synopsis/Solicitation for janitorial services at Virgin Islands National Park (Visitor Center, Facility Maintenance Building, and Resource Management & Science Building), St. John, USVI — NPS/Interior, small business total set-aside, NAICS 561720.
Reached the owner because NAICS 561720 matches exactly and Red Cedar qualifies under the small business set-aside, but the place of performance is ~2,100 miles from Oklahoma City, triggering the rc-distance 200-mile rule.
reasons_for: NAICS 561720 matches the solicitation exactly and Red Cedar is SBA-eligible, satisfying the Total Small Business set-aside with no teaming required [bfe39928-ec6a6e0c-p3-a98b36f5].

Firm's federal janitorial past performance (GSA Region 7 federal building, VA outpatient clinic) directly maps to the restroom, floor care, and custodial scope required across all five NPS locations [bfe39928-1256d376-p1-35356a2b].
QC program with CMMS-logged inspections and OSHA 30 supervisors satisfies the quality control and on-site supervisor designation requirements [bfe39928-948a5034-p2-dedea27e].
reasons_against: Place of performance is St. John, USVI (~2,100 miles from Oklahoma City), violating the rc-distance 200-mile rule — no USVI workforce, logistics, or inter-site transportation capability is documented in the profile [bfe39928-948a5034-p2-8c89e570].

On-site supervisor presence during every service period (8:00 AM–11:00 AM local, including weekends) cannot be met from Oklahoma City with no USVI-based staff, creating a fatal operational gap [bfe39928-1256d376-p6-350af9c5].

Accurate proposal pricing requires contractor verification of cleanable areas on-site in USVI, which is not feasible under the distance constraint, making a compliant price schedule submission unreliable [bfe39928-ec6a6e0c-p10-2edd7bd8].

source_quotes: The Government is also extending the quotation due date to September 8, 2026, at 12:00 PM EST to allow offerors sufficient time to review the updated information and prepare their proposals accordingly.

drafts.capability_statement:
Red Cedar Facility Services
Oklahoma City, OK | NAICS 561720 – Janitorial Services | Small Business | WOSB / EDWOSB

Red Cedar Facility Services is a Woman-Owned Small Business specializing in commercial and federal janitorial and custodial services under NAICS 561720. We are submitting this capability statement in response to Solicitation 140P5426Q0033 for Janitorial Services at Virgin Islands National Park.

Core Capabilities
Red Cedar delivers daily restroom sanitation, disinfectant cleaning, floor care, trash removal, and exterior surface wiping for federal and state facilities. Our standard scope covers all tasks identified in the SOW: toilet and urinal scrubbing, fixture polishing, mirror and countertop cleaning, windowsill wiping, sanitary receptacle servicing, and centralized trash consolidation.

Quality & Compliance
Our quality control program features scheduled inspections logged in a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS), enabling documented, auditable performance records. On-site supervisors hold OSHA 30 certification and carry full authority to act for the firm. We maintain an alternate supervisor designation to ensure uninterrupted coverage. All staff are enrolled in E-Verify. We operate a green cleaning program with CIMS-GB certification.

Relevant Past Performance
- Custodial Services, Oklahoma City Federal Building (GSA Region 7)
- Janitorial Services, State Office Complex (Oklahoma OMES)
- Housekeeping Support, Outpatient Clinic (VA Oklahoma City)

All references are available upon request with current points of contact.

We welcome the opportunity to discuss our qualifications with the Contracting Officer.

Contact: Red Cedar Facility Services | Oklahoma City, OK
questions_for_co: Transportation between sites (gap bfe39928-948a5034-p1-1c2ff9d5 / bfe39928-e1294258-p4-0f9c8519): The SOW requires the contractor to provide transportation between the three distinct sites and, if Government-provided storage is insufficient, to transport supplies and equipment daily. Can the Contracting Officer confirm whether a Government-furnished staging area or storage facility is available at each site, and whether there are any restrictions on the type of vehicle or vessel required for inter-site movement?

Site verification and price schedule (gap bfe39928-e1294258-p2-bac1fc6b / bfe39928-948a5034-p2-8c89e570): The SOW requires offerors to verify cleanable square footage and quantities before submitting the price schedule. Will the Government arrange or facilitate a site visit for prospective offerors, and if so, what is the scheduled date and point of contact for coordination?

Supervisor on-site presence and key personnel (gap bfe39928-e1294258-p3-d7bc3a41 / unknown bfe39928-1256d376-p5-a4393622 / unknown bfe39928-1256d376-p5-1b69ec6d): The solicitation confirms the supervisor or alternate must be physically on-site during every service period, including weekends. Must the designated supervisor and alternate both be residents of or permanently stationed in the USVI, or may they be mobilized from the continental United States provided they are present for each service window?

Liability insurance (unknown bfe39928-ec6a6e0c-p11-9cb4da05 / bfe39928-ec6a6e0c-p11-7ed5f2fa / bfe39928-ec6a6e0c-p11-ca5b87f5): The solicitation requires liability insurance of at least $50,000 per person, $100,000 per occurrence, and $100,000 property damage, with a certificate furnished to the Contracting Officer before work begins. Must the insuring company be licensed to do business in the U.S. Virgin Islands specifically, or is a policy issued by a nationally recognized carrier acceptable?

Contract base period length (unknown bfe39928-ec6a6e0c-p10-b548ee7b): The solicitation references an option provision that may be exercised for up to a total of 6 months of extensions, but the base period length is not stated in the documents provided. Can the Contracting Officer confirm the base period of performance (start date and duration)?

Electronic invoicing platform (unknown bfe39928-ec6a6e0c-p12-92710170): The solicitation states that payment requests must be submitted electronically. Can the Contracting Officer confirm which platform is required (e.g., IPP – Invoice Processing Platform) and whether new vendors must complete enrollment before contract award or before the first invoice submission?
